2023–24: 2,208 LEAs were surveyed; 1,579 responses were recorded, with a stated response rate of about 72%. After excluding 385 LEAs that did not offer TK, the report gives 1,823 remaining LEAs and the same 1,579 responses, stating an adjusted rate of 87%. It records 244 nonresponses or missed deadlines.

2024–25: 1,464 LEAs were surveyed; 952 responses were recorded, with a stated response rate of about 65%. Of respondents, 26 indicated they did not offer TK; 926 indicated at least one TK program, reported as 95%. That 95% describes program availability, not an adjusted survey response rate. The report records 512 nonresponses or missed deadlines.
